rules: Profile ids identify exact builds; target 1.6 or 1.7 alone is not an evidence identity.
Symbol ids include profile, assembly hash, declaring type, kind and full signature; display names are not unique keys.
Missing entries in partial coverage mean not_covered, never confirmed_absent.
Evidence levels are independent claims, not automatic implications.
Local machine paths, game DLLs and decompiled bodies are excluded from distributed catalogs.
